items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (August 2026)
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) that could lead to unauthenticated customer account takeover and privilege escalation. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (July 2026)
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical RCE
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of extensions, with two critical vulnerabilities that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks these critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (PHP Object Injection)
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9 on May 12th, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without backports.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (March 2026)
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.
